verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that users can register and sign in to Entra with passkeys (FIDO2) that eliminate passwords. Those passkeys can live on FIDO2 security keys, native or third-party passkey providers, or in Microsoft Authenticator, which covers the passkey and authenticator flows directly. Community reports of a FIDO downgrade attack describe a phishing weakness that depends on fallback methods staying enabled; they do not contradict that passwordless sign-in works, so the verdict is not disputed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of platform-biometric sign-in (e.g., Windows Hello) beyond the 'native passkey provider' wording, and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end passwordless employee flow.
